findings.desc: quality-cleanup: codex-adapter-checks.ts:77-81 resolveCodexSessionBriefCommand uses a fragile magic-suffix string slice (verifyCommand.slice(0, -" verify_codex".length)) to derive the session_brief command. The fallback at line 80 is hardcoded to "node bin/lattice-codex.js session_brief" regardless of project branding. If a future resolve candidate does not end with " verify_codex" (e.g. "lattice codex verify" which is already returned by the global-thin branch of resolveLocalCodexVerifyCommand), koala-branded projects would silently receive lattice-branded guidance. The invariant that all resolveLocalCodexVerifyCommand outputs end with " verify_codex" is implicit and has no dedicated test coverage protecting it.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit d7796b6f: resolveCodexSessionBriefCommand now uses explicit session_brief candidates for bin/lattice-codex.js, bin/koala-codex.js, bin/lattice.js, and bin/koala.js instead of suffix slicing; scripts/verify-codex-assets.mjs adds direct tests for lattice wrapper, legacy wrapper, koala.js-only fallback, and global-thin fallback. Verified build, test:codex-assets, test:entrypoints, validate --json parse, and node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex.

findings.desc: doc-code-drift: README wrapper priority list (line 291) documents 3 resolver candidates (`bin/lattice-codex.js > bin/koala-codex.js > bin/lattice.js`) but resolveLocalCodexVerifyCommand in codex-adapter-checks.ts has a 4th legacy fallback `bin/koala.js` → LEGACY_LOCAL_MAIN_VERIFY_COMMAND. A user whose repo has only `bin/koala.js` (no codex or lattice wrappers) would receive gate remediation `node bin/koala.js verify_codex` but the documented priority list omits this candidate. The plan.md CHK-001 plan explicitly lists all four candidates including `bin/koala.js`. `bin/koala.js` is mentioned elsewhere in README as `legacy bootstrap alias` (line 12) but not in the priority guidance paragraph.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit d7796b6f: README wrapper priority paragraph now documents bin/koala.js as the fourth legacy generic bootstrap fallback, matching resolveLocalCodexVerifyCommand. Verified npm run test:codex-assets and npm run test:entrypoints.

findings.desc: quality-cleanup: scripts/verify-codex-assets.mjs:267-280 assertSessionBriefCommand tests cover candidates 1 (bin/lattice-codex.js), 2 (bin/koala-codex.js), 4 (bin/koala.js) and global-thin, but the 3rd priority candidate bin/lattice.js → "node bin/lattice.js session_brief" (codex-adapter-checks.ts:80) has no direct test case. If the mapping is changed in future, there is no regression guard for this path. Minor test coverage gap only.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit d07174d4: scripts/verify-codex-assets.mjs now includes a direct resolveCodexSessionBriefCommand test for bin/lattice.js-only fallback returning node bin/lattice.js session_brief. Verified npm run test:codex-assets plus full build, entrypoints, validate --json parse, and verify_codex.
